column3: Inspired by the NewJeans bunny mascot vibe but an ORIGINAL design (do not copy any official logo): soft white and pastel sky-blue. Head = a small glossy white cube with two tall rounded pastel-blue bunny ears and a tiny pink nose dot. Trail = soft white fluffy band with a pastel-blue stripe edge and tiny paw/heart dots. Particles = little floating pastel hearts and white fluff puffs. Palette: white, pastel sky blue, baby pink, soft navy accent.

Y2K 2000s denim aesthetic: indigo-blue jean fabric texture with diagonal twill weave, bright mustard/orange double stitching along both edges, little copper rivets. Head = a denim cube with a copper rivet and stitched pocket outline. Particles = tiny denim scraps, orange thread loops and copper rivet sparks. Palette: indigo, washed light denim, mustard-orange stitch, copper.

Bubblegum pop: glossy candy-pink, strawberry milk, mint accents. Head = a glossy pink gum cube with a shiny highlight and a small inflated bubble. Trail = glossy pink gum ribbon with soft highlight streak and tiny sprinkles. Particles = translucent pink soap/gum bubbles that pop into rings. Palette: hot candy pink, pale strawberry milk, mint, white gloss.

Y2K flip-phone LCD pixel look: monochrome backlit LCD screen green-blue / cyan with dark pixel grid, chunky 8-bit pixels. Head = a pixel-art cube with a tiny pixel heart / antenna glyph, LCD glow. Trail = a strip of LCD pixels (visible square pixel grid, subtle scanlines). Particles = square chunky pixels and pixel stars blinking. Palette: LCD mint-cyan backlight, deep LCD navy pixel, pale silver phone shell, soft pink pixel accent.

Soft nostalgic camcorder / VHS film look inspired by a wintry high-school film mood: muted blue-grey, snow white, faded film grain, light leaks. Head = a frosted milky blue-grey cube with soft film grain and a warm light-leak corner. Trail = a 35mm film strip band with sprocket holes on both edges, faded blue-grey frames. Particles = soft snowflakes and dust specks / film grain motes. Palette: misty blue-grey, snow white, faded slate, warm amber light-leak.

Y2K chrome and neon: liquid mirror chrome silver with iridescent holographic sheen, electric blue and neon violet glow edges. Head = a liquid-chrome cube with holographic reflections and neon rim. Trail = brushed chrome ribbon with an iridescent rainbow sheen and neon edge lines. Particles = neon star sparkles (4-point Y2K stars) and chrome droplets. Palette: chrome silver, electric blue, neon violet, holographic pastel rainbow.
